description: POST /v1/paymaster/clients - mints a publishable clientId scoped to the given origins and chains. `mode` (default live) fixes the network class: a live key (pmc_live_*) may only allow mainnet chains, a test key (pmc_test_*) only testnets. The clientId is safe to ship in dApp bundles.

gasMode.description: sponsored (default): the merchant pays gas; user_paid: the user pays gas in an ERC-20 via context.token; both.

name: paymaster_clients_create
title: Create a paymaster client
